info.title: Nodera Core API
info.description: Infrastructure, AI, Agent, and Operations control plane. This spec covers exactly the endpoints implemented today — see docs/ROADMAP.md in the repository for what's planned. Hand-maintained (docs/ROADMAP.md tracks generating it from code instead).

tags.name: ai
tags.description: AI Gateway: profiles, provider/model registry, chat

tags.name: agents
tags.description: Agent identity, scoped chat, and scoped tool execution (not an autonomous tool-calling loop — a caller directs which tool an agent uses)

bearerAuth.description: A session token (POST /auth/login) or an API token (POST /api-tokens / POST /service-accounts/{id}/api-tokens). See docs/API.md Authenticating.

OrgHeader.name: X-Nodera-Org
OrgHeader.description: Required for a session token (which org to act within). Optional for an API token, which already embeds one — if present it must match.

scopes.description: Must be a subset of the caller's own permissions

token.description: The raw token — shown exactly once, never retrievable again

permission_scope.description: Permission keys this agent acts with — never broader than its creator's own permissions at creation time

allowed_tool_keys.description: Each key must already exist in the tool registry

permission_scope.description: Must be a subset of the caller's own permissions

Page.description: The standard pagination envelope every paginated list endpoint returns (internal/platform/httpserver.Page). Concrete endpoints narrow `items`'s element type via allOf — see NodePage, ApplicationPage, JobPage, AuditRecordPage.

JobRef.description: Returned when an operation is queued (202). created=false means an idempotent duplicate returned the existing job.

GatewayResult.description: Dangerous operations answer 202 with approval_required; nothing runs until a human approves.

Certificate.description: The private key is never returned by any endpoint.

files.description: upload only: relative path -> base64 content

source_config.description: Non-secret descriptors only; keys that look like secrets are rejected.

credentials.description: Stored encrypted; never returned or logged.

NotificationChannelInput.description: Webhook targets are validated against the SSRF policy; email delivery reports 'SMTP is not configured' until SMTP exists.

LogEntry.description: Messages are redacted for credentials before storage.

RetentionPolicy.description: retention_days 0 = keep forever (no default and no policy).

DashboardSummary.description: Sections the caller may not read are omitted.

AIPlan.description: The AI only proposes. Steps are vetted against the real operation registry; a human approves and runs each step with their own permissions.

AgentRegistration.description: The one-time enrolment token is shown exactly once and stored only as a hash.

available.description: false when no container provider is configured
